text.tspan: Spatial Transformer submodule | Operators & tensor flow
Net.stn only / MNIST28x28 / learned affine / grid and image operands / static / read bottom to top
B: batch; theta:[B,2,3]; grid:[B,H,W,2] in normalized(x,y) coordinates
Solid side route: original image values; dashed side route: shape x.size()
Library boundaries: affine_grid and grid_sample; omitted API arguments remain omitted
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
